test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Much of the beauty and glory of life have disappeared.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the subject-verb agreement error.
 
• "**Much**" is a singular noun, which takes a singular verb. Therefore, the verb should be "has" instead of "have."
 
• The correct sentence should be "Much of the beauty and glory of life has disappeared."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part D** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **D**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Much of the beauty and glory of life **has** disappeared."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "Much of the"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **B: "beauty and glory"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "of life"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
